color.daily.capture.background.element: screen background behind header, viewfinder and controls
color.daily.capture.background.evidence: references/auto/bereal/frames/appstore-preview-2026_t3.50s_capture.png block x200-700 y20-120 and x100-800 y1700-1900; references/auto/bereal/help/help-21083708285725_bts-post-preview-2x.png x300-500 y20-60
color.daily.capture.background.notes: Same #000000 on the feed (H3 above post) and post preview (H2).

color.daily.capture.countdown.text.method: median of top-10% luminance pixels in a lossless 2x PNG (max 250 while the iOS status bar in the same file is 255)
color.daily.capture.countdown.text.notes: All other BeReal app text in references/auto/bereal/help/help-21083730354333_feed-bonus-3x.png is also 250,250,250 (e.g. 'My Friends' x230-520 y300-370). Lossy video samples: AP #106 (253,250,254), TT #510 (255,254,255) — consistent within compression.

color.daily.capture.shutter.evidence: references/auto/bereal/frames/appstore-preview-2026_t3.50s_capture.png ring y1505-1509 x438-450, disc y1575-1600 x430-457
color.daily.capture.shutter.method: mean of core pixels: ring (252,250,251), disc (252,249,253)
color.daily.capture.shutter.notes: Lossy sources cannot distinguish #FFFFFF from BeReal's #FAFAFA text white; no lossless capture-screen image found.

color.daily.capture.mode.selected.notes: Low confidence. Mode labels exist only in the 2026 build.

color.daily.dualimage.inset.border.element: solid border around the front-camera inset
color.daily.dualimage.inset.border.evidence: references/auto/bereal/help/help-21083730354333_feed-bonus-3x.png rows 1992-1994 x150-300 and cols 36-38 y2200-2400; references/auto/bereal/help/help-21083730407325_bts-gif-frame48.png rows 24-27
color.daily.dualimage.inset.border.method: median and max of border core (H3: 0,0,0 exactly; HG: median 0,0,2)

dimension.daily.capture.viewfinder.width.evidence: references/auto/bereal/frames/appstore-preview-2026_t3.50s_capture.png left edge 15.64 px, right edge 869.35 px
dimension.daily.capture.viewfinder.width.method: subpixel max-gradient edge, median of 801 rows; pt = px / 2.2545 (AP frame 886 px = 393 pt screen; verified 1:1 by wordmark width 161-162 px)
dimension.daily.capture.viewfinder.width.notes: = screen width minus ≈7 pt each side. 2024 (TT) and 2023 (H2) builds were full-bleed (whole screen width).

dimension.daily.capture.viewfinder.sideM.element: gap between viewfinder and screen edge (2026)
dimension.daily.capture.viewfinder.sideM.method: pt = px / 2.2545 (AP frame 886 px = 393 pt screen; verified 1:1 by wordmark width 161-162 px)

dimension.daily.capture.viewfinder.top.element: viewfinder top edge, from top of screen (status bar hidden)
dimension.daily.capture.viewfinder.top.method: subpixel edge, median of 501 columns; pt = px / 2.2545 (AP frame 886 px = 393 pt screen; verified 1:1 by wordmark width 161-162 px)

radius.daily.capture.viewfinder.method: circle fit to edge-profile offsets (r=36.0/35.75 px, rms 0.34 px); pt = px / 2.2545 (AP frame 886 px = 393 pt screen; verified 1:1 by wordmark width 161-162 px)
radius.daily.capture.viewfinder.notes: Circular-fit radius; whether the corner is continuous (squircle) cannot be resolved at this resolution.

dimension.daily.capture.shutter.outer.element: shutter outer diameter (2026: white ring + white disc)
dimension.daily.capture.shutter.outer.method: threshold-128 crossings; pt = px / 2.2545 (AP frame 886 px = 393 pt screen; verified 1:1 by wordmark width 161-162 px)
dimension.daily.capture.shutter.outer.notes: 2024 build (TT #510) used a hollow ring only: 148 px / 1.846 = 80 pt outer, stroke ≈0.074 × diameter.

dimension.daily.capture.shutter.ringStro.method: threshold-128 crossings; pt = px / 2.2545 (AP frame 886 px = 393 pt screen; verified 1:1 by wordmark width 161-162 px)

dimension.daily.capture.shutter.gap.element: black gap between ring and inner disc (2026)
dimension.daily.capture.shutter.gap.method: threshold-128 crossings; pt = px / 2.2545 (AP frame 886 px = 393 pt screen; verified 1:1 by wordmark width 161-162 px)

dimension.daily.capture.shutter.disc.method: threshold-128 crossings; pt = px / 2.2545 (AP frame 886 px = 393 pt screen; verified 1:1 by wordmark width 161-162 px)

layout.daily.capture.shutter.centerY.element: shutter centre from top of an 852 pt screen (= 148 pt above bottom); horizontally centred
layout.daily.capture.shutter.centerY.method: midpoint of crossings; pt = px / 2.2545 (AP frame 886 px = 393 pt screen; verified 1:1 by wordmark width 161-162 px)
layout.daily.capture.shutter.centerY.notes: Flash and flip glyphs are vertically centred on the same line (centre y 1586.5 px).

layout.daily.capture.flash.centerX.element: flash-off glyph centre from left screen edge
layout.daily.capture.flash.centerX.method: bbox centre; pt = px / 2.2545 (AP frame 886 px = 393 pt screen; verified 1:1 by wordmark width 161-162 px)

layout.daily.capture.flip.centerXFromRig.element: flip-camera glyph centre from right screen edge
layout.daily.capture.flip.centerXFromRig.method: bbox centre; pt = px / 2.2545 (AP frame 886 px = 393 pt screen; verified 1:1 by wordmark width 161-162 px)

dimension.daily.capture.countdown.digitH.method: threshold-128 bbox; AP: pt = px / 2.2545 (AP frame 886 px = 393 pt screen; verified 1:1 by wordmark width 161-162 px); H2: px/2

font.size.daily.capture.countdown.element: countdown font size for the platform font
font.size.daily.capture.countdown.method: derived: measured digit height 16.4-16.5 pt ÷ 0.705 (SF Pro cap-height ratio; digits ≈ cap height)
font.size.daily.capture.countdown.notes: Derivation for a PLATFORM font, not BeReal's own value. Verify by side-by-side digit height.

font.daily.capture.countdown.evidence: no reliable source names BeReal's UI font (fan claims: Inter / Texta Heavy / Genera Grotesk — conflicting)
font.daily.capture.countdown.notes: Weight not measurable; stem width = 0.19-0.20 × digit height (H2 '1' stem x370-375 at y222, '0' side stroke 6.6 px of 33). Match in verification. Tabular figures: undetermined.

layout.daily.capture.countdown.position.value: centred under the title, digits top 92.3 pt from screen top; 10.2 pt below title; 16.2 pt above viewfinder
layout.daily.capture.countdown.position.evidence: references/auto/bereal/frames/appstore-preview-2026_t3.50s_capture.png title bottom y185, digits y208-244 (centre x 441 vs screen 443), viewfinder top 280
layout.daily.capture.countdown.position.method: differences; pt = px / 2.2545 (AP frame 886 px = 393 pt screen; verified 1:1 by wordmark width 161-162 px)

layout.daily.capture.modeLabels.value: row of VIDEO · PHOTO between viewfinder and shutter; selected label centred and yellow; cap height 9.1 pt; row centre 647.6 pt; 12.2 pt below viewfinder; 14.9 pt above shutter
layout.daily.capture.modeLabels.method: bbox; pt = px / 2.2545 (AP frame 886 px = 393 pt screen; verified 1:1 by wordmark width 161-162 px)
layout.daily.capture.modeLabels.notes: Absent in 2024 (TT). Only relevant if daily capture has a mode switch.

dimension.daily.capture.retake.button.element: retake ✕ circle diameter on the post-preview image
dimension.daily.capture.retake.button.evidence: references/auto/bereal/help/help-21083708285725_bts-post-preview-2x.png circle x694-761 y288-355 (2x); cross-check S2 x1022-1106 = 0.083 × main width
dimension.daily.capture.retake.button.notes: Glyph 14 × 14 pt (H2 bbox 714-741 × 308-335). Fill: dark translucent (S2 luminance 42-45 over bright photo); H2 sits under a dim hint overlay so its colours are not representative.

dimension.daily.capture.retake.inset.element: retake ✕ distance from the image's top and right edges
dimension.daily.capture.retake.inset.evidence: references/auto/bereal/help/help-21083708285725_bts-post-preview-2x.png circle right 761 → image edge 786 (25 px); top 288 − image top 264 (24 px)

dimension.daily.capture.progress.size.element: arc spinner shown between and during captures
dimension.daily.capture.progress.size.notes: White open arc, centred in the viewfinder area, with one line of prompt text centred below it.

icon.daily.capture.dismiss.element: down-chevron at top-left of capture screen
icon.daily.capture.dismiss.evidence: references/auto/bereal/frames/appstore-preview-2026_t3.50s_capture.png bbox x56-87 y159-177 (centre 31.7 pt from left, 74.5 pt from top)
icon.daily.capture.dismiss.method: visual match of reference glyph to platform symbol

icon.daily.capture.flash.off.element: flash toggle (off state), left of shutter
icon.daily.capture.flash.off.method: visual match of reference glyph to platform symbol

icon.daily.capture.flip.element: switch front/back camera, right of shutter
icon.daily.capture.flip.method: visual match of reference glyph to platform symbol

icon.daily.capture.retake.element: retake (discard pair) on post preview, top-right of image
icon.daily.capture.retake.method: visual match of reference glyph to platform symbol

duration.daily.capture.countdown.tick.evidence: https://www.tiktok.com/@bereal/video/7339559678604627233 tick starts at frames #484 and #514; AP new-digit settle #95 and #125

duration.daily.capture.countdown.digitOu.element: changed digit slides up and fades out
duration.daily.capture.countdown.digitOu.method: first-changed to last-visible frame at 30 fps
duration.daily.capture.countdown.digitOu.notes: Only changed digits move; at a minute boundary 3 digits roll together (TT #513-#526).

duration.daily.capture.countdown.digitIn.element: new digit rises from below to its rest position
duration.daily.capture.countdown.digitIn.evidence: https://www.tiktok.com/@bereal/video/7339559678604627233 start+9 frames (#484→#493), start+10-11 (#514→#524/525); references/auto/bereal/frames/appstore-preview-2026_t3.50s_capture.png start+9 (#116→#125); lossless still references/auto/bereal/help/help-21083708285725_bts-post-preview-2x.png
duration.daily.capture.countdown.digitIn.notes: Curve not measurable (position samples 120.7, 119.1, 117.8, 116.7, 115.9 px flatten towards rest). First visible ≈3 pt below rest.

duration.daily.capture.countdown.digitFa.method: frame count at 30 fps (16-18 frames after tick start)

duration.daily.capture.shutter.press.method: uniform scale from bbox width at 30 fps

duration.daily.capture.shutter.dismiss.element: shutter keeps shrinking to 0 while controls leave (press start → gone)

duration.daily.capture.viewfinder.fadeOu.element: live viewfinder fades to black after press

duration.daily.capture.betweenShots.element: black screen with spinner + prompt before the back photo is shown
duration.daily.capture.betweenShots.notes: One device (390 pt iPhone, 2024 build); camera-dependent.

duration.daily.capture.backPhoto.fadeIn.element: captured back photo fades in behind spinner + prompt

duration.daily.capture.secondCapture.element: back photo shown with spinner + prompt while the front capture runs

duration.daily.capture.total.element: shutter press → post preview with inset

duration.daily.capture.promptAfter.element: post-capture prompt line stays on the preview (at least)
duration.daily.capture.promptAfter.evidence: https://www.tiktok.com/@bereal/video/7339559678604627233 #600-#681 (end of video); FJ: 'flash up for less than 3 seconds'
duration.daily.capture.promptAfter.notes: Text itself is do-not-copy (smile directive); duration recorded for a neutral line, if any.

radius.daily.dualimage.main.method: circle fit to edge profile; px/3 and px/2 → 17.8 / 17.9 pt
radius.daily.dualimage.main.notes: Ratio 0.0455 × main width. 2026 lossy feed frames give 14.9-16.4 pt (low confidence).

layout.daily.dualimage.main.width.value: full width (393 pt) in 2023-24 feed and preview; 368-374 pt in 2026 feed
layout.daily.dualimage.main.width.notes: 2026 width varies between frames (possibly a horizontal pager) — unexplained.

layout.daily.dualimage.inset.widthRatio.element: inset outer width ÷ main image width
layout.daily.dualimage.inset.widthRatio.notes: Outliers not used: S2 marketing panel 0.335; AP #250 0.289.

dimension.daily.dualimage.inset.width.element: inset outer width when main image is 393 pt wide
dimension.daily.dualimage.inset.width.notes: Use the ratio token (0.31 × main width) when the main image is narrower.

layout.daily.dualimage.inset.marginRatio.element: inset margin from main image top and left ÷ main width (equal on both axes)

dimension.daily.dualimage.inset.margin.element: inset margin at 393 pt main width

dimension.daily.dualimage.inset.border.element: inset border width (solid, outside the photo)
dimension.daily.dualimage.inset.border.evidence: references/auto/bereal/help/help-21083730354333_feed-bonus-3x.png 6.0 px (outer 34.72 → inner 40.72, etc.); references/auto/bereal/help/help-21083730407325_bts-gif-frame48.png 4 px; references/auto/bereal/frames/appstore-preview-2026_t6.80s_feed.png 4.1-4.4 px (1.9 pt); references/auto/bereal/store/bereal-store-03.png 5.0/1008 × 393 = 2.0 pt

radius.daily.dualimage.inset.outer.method: circle fit to outer edge profile; /3 and /2
radius.daily.dualimage.inset.outer.notes: Ratio 0.126 × inset outer width. Inner (photo) radius = outer − border ≈ 13.5 pt (derived).

dimension.daily.dualimage.retake.inset.element: preview: retake ✕ distance from image top/right (same as inset margin)
